name: SpeakCode
tagline: Interview practice that scores how you explain your code, not just whether it passes.
problem: Coding-practice platforms ignore the verbal reasoning that interviews actually assess.
solution: A multimodal practice platform that records your explanation while you code and evaluates logic articulation and technical clarity alongside the solution.
demo_moment: Team-described: solve a problem aloud and get feedback on your explanation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Names a specific gap ('communication gap') in practice platforms.

lessons: Find the part of a familiar task that existing tools ignore.
